Open Shifts, then Today. Read the assigned overnight A Shift card.
Enter Community in Search shifts and open Community standby signup. Read its approval rule, Open needs and saved Scheduled roster entries.

Open Calendar, filter to the practice shift and select the intended date. Open its day card and read its group role requirements and roster.
Inspect On Duty, then Trades and Approvals. Capture the actual returned states; do not assume queues will always be empty.
